results.title: r/automation on Reddit: What's your audio transcription workflow?
results.snippet: Notion IA transcribe (AI note-taking) are magic. But it is too expensive.

results.title: r/selfpublish on Reddit: Anyone here use speech to text for writing?
results.snippet: I used speech input plus a little AI-clean up to write this comment because I’m trying to practice developing the skill of voice input. It’s not exactly the way I would type this out, but I’m getting better at speech input. I am super motivated to do that so I can get rid of screens and keyboards and office chairs forever! ... Thanks for this, I could never think about using something like Notion to organize audio notes. I find Ultimate Brain too expensive for me to invest into, and I don't need anything to organize the texts I write, just to record them and convert them into text.
